name: Exa

server.title: Exa
server.description: Exa web search, page fetching and research-agent tools for AI agents over MCP.

protocolMetadata.instructions: Only use tools returned by tools/list. If web_search_exa is listed, use it to find relevant pages and current information by describing the page you want to find. If web_fetch_exa is listed, use it to read known URLs when search highlights are insufficient or you already have a URL. If agent_run is listed, use it for multi-step research, list-building, or enrichment. If a run is still running, continue with its runId rather than starting a duplicate run.

tool.name: web_search_exa
tool.title: Web Search
tool.description:
Search the web for any topic and get clean, ready-to-use content.

      Best for: Finding current information, news, facts, people, companies, or answering questions about any topic.
      Returns: Clean text content from top search results.

      Query tips:
      describe the ideal page, not keywords. "blog post comparing React and Vue performance" not "React vs Vue".
      Use category:people / category:company to search through Linkedin profiles / companies respectively.
      If highlights are insufficient, follow up with web_fetch_exa on the best URLs.

query.description: Natural language search query. Should be a semantically rich description of the ideal page, not just keywords. Optionally include category:<type> (company, people) to focus results — e.g. 'category:people John Doe software engineer'.

objective.description: Goal for this search turn; say which documents should rank first, which should be excluded, and what specific facts or figures to pull from them.

tool.name: agent_run
tool.title: Run Exa Agent
tool.description: Start or resume an Exa Agent run for multi-step research, list-building, or enrichment. Use it instead of running many searches yourself when a task needs multiple searches, cross-source verification, or a structured table of results. Long-running: returns a run ID; resume with runId when the tool reports the run is still running. Not for a single question or lookup (use web_search_exa) or reading a known URL (use web_fetch_exa). An interrupted tool call is not an explicit cancellation request.

exclusion.description: Entities, rows, or records Agent should avoid returning again.

query.description: Natural-language research or enrichment objective. Provide query or runId, not both.

runId.description: ID returned by an earlier call. Use it to check or continue waiting for the same run. Do not start a duplicate run.

maxCostDollars.description: Maximum spend for the run in US dollars, $1–$100. Only for effort auto or ultra; defaults to $5 for auto and $20 for ultra.

maxDurationSeconds.description: Soft wall-clock limit in seconds, 300–10800. Only for effort ultra; the run returns what it has found as it nears the limit.

budget.description: Optional per-run spend and duration limits for the metered auto and ultra efforts. Set it when the user names a cost or time limit.

effort.description: Agent effort level. Defaults to low.

provider.description: Exa Connect provider ID. Self-serve providers: fiber, financial_datasets, similarweb, baselayer, affiliate, particle, jinko, polymarket, macrobond. Other providers work only when enabled for your Exa team.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Exa to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Exa to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Exa MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 16, 2026, Exa scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Exa's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 16, 2026, Exa scores 84/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 3 of 3 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Exa MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exa provides these MCP tools: web_search_exa and get_code_context_exa.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Exa?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Exa in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.
Exa requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Exa is developed by Exa. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
